title: Visualisations
headline: Closed (stale, no update since 2026-10-31T18:20:00Z). The flying-fish blueprint is drawn in 3D at /blueprint3d/: 536 distinct ontology terms (13 organ systems, 67 organs, 198 tissues, 257 cell types) and 674 part_of edges, each node showing its term, the SPARQL query that produced it, and the kernel-checked structural certificate that covers it beside the biological Lean statement it does not have (0 of 536 terms appear in any Lean statement); the canvas says the layout is a projection of the ontology hierarchy, not anatomy. /graph/ now hides its 213 datasets by default (toggle to show) and has an Ideas view: 10 ideas from decisions/ideas.json, 0 researched, 7 reach-synthesis (not yet checked against prior art), 3 serendipitous, each linked to the nodes or repo areas it affects. Genes are not drawn yet because genotype/map.json does not exist.
